checks.heading: Appendix F — Running an Experimental Study: From Question to Credible Evidence

figures.alt: Target population branches through random sampling into an evaluation sample and people not in the evaluation. Only the evaluation sample proceeds through random assignment to treatment and control groups. External validity and internal validity appear as unboxed side labels beside the corresponding procedures.
figures.caption: Figure F.2: Random sampling supports generalization to the target population; random assignment supports a causal comparison within the evaluation sample.
